Uday Menon
Senior QA Automation Engineer | Noida, Uttar Pradesh
uday.menon137@example.com | +91 9328763948

Experienced QA automation engineer with a strong background in building reliable test suites for web and API platforms. Focused on improving release quality through robust automation, CI integration and clear documentation. Open to immediate opportunities; notice period: 15 days.

Experience
Pixelwave Studios — Jan 2022 - Mar 2026
Senior QA Automation Engineer (Remote/Hybrid)
- Designed and maintained a JUnit-based regression suite that reduced manual test cycles by 70% and caught 35% more pre-release defects over two years using Test Automation best practices.
- Implemented Selenium-driven end-to-end tests for cross-browser game portals, increasing UI test coverage to 82% and lowering post-release UI bugs by 48%.
- Built and ran Postman collections for API contract verification during CI, reducing API-related incidents by 40% and enabling daily verification runs.
- Integrated test runs with Jenkins pipelines to provide automated nightly test reports and faster feedback loops, cutting average bug turnaround from 5 days to 2 days.

GreenGrid — Dec 2021 - Dec 2021
QA Automation Engineer (Contract)
- Rapidly developed Test Automation scripts with Selenium and JUnit for a time-boxed sprint to validate new energy dashboard features, achieving a 90% pass rate on CI smoke checks.
- Created Postman test suites that validated API stability under simulated loads, identifying and reporting three critical endpoints with inconsistent responses.
- Documented test cases and results in Confluence and tracked defects in Jira to streamline handoffs between QA and engineering teams.

Paystack India — Mar 2019 - Nov 2021
Test Engineer (Onsite)
- Authored and executed Postman-based API regression suites for payments services, preventing multiple critical production regressions during merchant onboarding changes.
- Wrote JUnit integration tests for backend services and integrated them into Jenkins jobs to enable automated pre-deploy checks, reducing deployment rollbacks by 30%.
- Coordinated test plans and defect triage through Jira, improving SLA adherence for bug resolution and enhancing cross-team visibility via Confluence documentation.

Projects
- Internal Test Framework: Developed a reusable Java test framework combining Selenium and JUnit for cross-project use, reducing test setup time by 60% for new modules.
- API Health Monitor: Built Postman collections and Jenkins jobs to monitor key API endpoints 24/7, with automated alerts for response-time and error-rate thresholds.
